Erik Bergstrom  
San Francisco, CA | +1 (415) 555-0198 | erik.bergstrom@email.com | linkedin.com/in/erikbergstrom  

**Professional Experience**  
*Platform Engineer* | ScaleTech Solutions (2022–Present)  
Led the design and maintenance of a Kubernetes-based platform supporting 12+ SaaS products. Spearheaded the migration of 80% of workloads to managed Kubernetes, reducing infrastructure costs by 32% annually. Optimized VPC architecture across three regions, improving network latency by 18% for critical services. Implemented GitLab CI pipelines for 90% of platform updates, cutting deployment time from 45 minutes to 12.  

*SRE Engineer* | DataFlow Systems (2020–2022)  
Architected scalable cloud networking solutions using AWS VPC and subnet tagging, resolving 95% of routing conflicts within 24 hours. Automated load balancing configurations for 15+ microservices, achieving 99.95% SLA compliance. Deployed Prometheus/Grafana dashboards to monitor 50+ metrics across 100+ nodes, enabling proactive issue resolution.  

*DevOps Engineer* | CloudNova Inc. (2018–2020)  
Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines for 12 internal tools, reducing manual intervention by 65%. Designed Terraform modules for AWS resource provisioning, standardizing 80% of infrastructure code. Pioneered Python scripts to automate SSH key management, eliminating 200+ manual tasks monthly.

- **Monitoring**: Prometheus, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch  
- **Networking**: VPC subnet design, load balancing, BGP routing  
- **Scripting**: Python (async/await, REST API integrations)

**Projects / Side Projects**

Developed a Terraform/Ansible hybrid tool to provision multi-region VPCs, reducing setup time by 70%. Integrated with GitLab CI for automated testing, ensuring compliance with 15+ security policies.  

*Self-Service Kubernetes Cluster Portal* | 2022  
Built a web app using Python/Flask to let teams spin up clusters with preconfigured namespaces and policies. Reduced onboarding time for new projects by 50% and cut support tickets related to cluster setup by 40%.  

*Performance Optimization Dashboard* | 2021  
Created a Grafana-based dashboard to visualize Kubernetes node utilization and network throughput. Identified underutilized resources in 3 clusters, leading to a 25% reduction in cloud spend.
